brief:
Turkish Air Force aerobatic jets performed a dramatic demonstration flight over Egypt's Pyramids of Giza, Al Jazeera English reported. The military's specialized aerobatic team conducted the spectacular aerial display above the ancient monument, executing precision maneuvers at the historic site.

The flyover represented a coordinated aerial performance by the Turkish military unit trained in high-precision aerobatic flying. Specifics regarding the purpose, timing, and any formal coordination between Turkish and Egyptian authorities for the demonstration were not immediately disclosed. The Pyramids of Giza remain among the world's most recognizable archaeological landmarks and frequent sites of ceremonial and commemorative events.

title: Turkish air force executes flyover above Egypt's pyramids
